subject.title: feat: persist the Manage Stock toggle both ways

question: Which storage-backed atomicity mechanism should this pilot use to ensure an explicit Manage Stock disable cannot be overwritten or partially completed?
rationale: The required guarantee spans a catalog record and registration claims; the current collection API exposes only independent reads, writes, queries, and deletes, so choosing the durable mechanism requires maintainer judgment.

options.title: Add an atomic persistence primitive
options.body: Adopt a transaction or compare-and-swap mechanism that commits the toggle and guards Configure Inventory against the same revision.

options.title: Narrow the feature until atomicity exists
options.body: Defer claim release and concurrent Configure Inventory support until the storage layer provides a durable conditional-write contract.

recommendation.title: Add an atomic persistence primitive
recommendation.body: Adopt a transaction or compare-and-swap mechanism that commits the toggle and guards Configure Inventory against the same revision.

likelyOwner.reason: The submitted implementation and proof cover the affected catalog and inventory paths.
